definitions.short: something high in value , i.e. perhaps coral
definitions.full: H7215. ramoth I. רָאמוֺת noun [feminine plural] usually corals (so Ki; black corals Thes ( מְּנִינִים = red corals ); compare Arabic , sea-shell , We Heid. 2. 163 ); — as costly Job 28:18 , as merchandise, רָאמֹת Ezek 27:16 ; — חָכְמוֺת לֶאֱוִיל רָאמוֺת Prov 24:7 , reading and sense dubious, see Toy. רָֽאֲמָה , II. רָאמַת רָאמוֺת, see רום , II. רמה . above
